input: Whether records are still being completed and whether the filmstrip worker still has work.
output: Orders: the filmstrip worker takes clips of its own or waits; the wave worker takes clips of its own or makes only the open clip's wave. It reads nothing, writes nothing and runs no worker.
specification: User 2026-10-18: records first, then filmstrips (a clip up to 10 s read through, a longer one the intra picture nearest each of 13 places), then waves (a wave reads the sound of every frame). The open clip's wave never waits. Replaces 2026-10-15 (filmstrip after each wave).
